summary: Evaxion A/S filed a Form 6-K on June 11, 2026, furnishing a press release titled 'Evaxion presents new preclinical data for EVX-04, an off-the-shelf therapeutic vaccine for acute myeloid leukemia.' The filing reports standard operational progress for a clinical-stage biotech company—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, abrupt management change, or other special situation is described. The press release purely concerns preclinical data presentation at the EHA 2026 Congress. As a routine disclosure of scientific milestones by a foreign private issuer, this filing does not constitute a special situation event.
